assets.orientationExposure: Upper fold/crown receives sun and sky; lower inner overlap is sheltered.

assets.geometryVsMaterial: Fold radius, gravity wrinkles and hem thickness are geometry. Terry loops/weave remain material microstructure pending higher-quality Unity maps.

assets.manufacture: Assumed cut-and-sewn cotton jersey T-shirt modeled as separate front/back jersey panels with hollow open-cuff sleeves, open waist and rib collar, supported by a separate molded PP hanger. This is an original unbranded interpretation, not a historical SKU claim.
assets.mounting: Hanger ownership is retained in the existing laundry generator; external placement may hook onto LaundryPole2560 without duplicating pole geometry.
assets.interfaces: Static sleeve-root overlap and side/shoulder seam geometry approximate sewn construction while preserving neck, waist and cuff passages. Hanger/cloth collision and cloth dynamics remain unverified.
assets.orientationExposure: Front/shoulder are most sun/sky exposed; interior and back are sheltered. Dry hanging reference; wind pose not simulated.
assets.agingCausality: Clean laundered reference. No invented sweat, yellowing, tears or stains.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Panel separation, sleeve cavities, folded hems, collar, seams and close-LOD stitch dashes are geometry. Knit loops/fuzz and distant stitching are material microstructure.
